_comment: CFG-6: the demo, and the fastest way to see the whole pipeline. A profile is partial - it states what it changes and nothing else.
_comment_bible: How much canon a book this size can carry. 3 chapters, about 1,400 words. A cast of three is a cast a reader meets once and remembers. Every profile states these now: inheriting one set of counts for every length is how a three-chapter run and a thirty-four-chapter novel ended up with the same Story Bible.
